title: Breast Self-Awareness
subtitle: Risk reduction, screening, evidence, and practical considerations for breast self-awareness.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports breast self-awareness as a valuable adjunct to clinical screening but does not support breast self-examination as a mortality-reducing intervention. Emerging evidence clarifies the physiological basis of breast tissue variability aiding interpretation of self-awareness.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
